name: Sausage Factory
summary: You're working the night shift at the sausage factory, and your job rests on the precise control of meat-smashing machinery. One to four players can enjoy quality time hovering over the same keyboard, smashing meat in careful rhythm, trying desperately to keep their jobs night after night. Satisfy the boss and you'll live to work another day, but do your best to leave the human parts for the grinder.
